after5_start.name: {name}
after5_start.text: *The event is winding down. I naturally run into the two I didn't choose.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *In front of the school gate. I can see three figures in the distance. Seoyeon walking with Haeun, Dain tossing a volleyball as she runs, Yuna reading a book as she walks slowly.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *I can't easily say I'm sorry. Those feelings aren't something that can be neatly wrapped up with that word. So just in my heart, slowly. Thank you.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I walked to the back of the school.*

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I knew. You were a variable not in my plan.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: Next time, I'll be the one to take you.

after5_farewell_seo_6_ins.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_6_ins.text: *Seoyeon turns and waves. — The same gesture as Day 1. She doesn't look back.*

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *I'm left alone in the hallway. Seoyeon's footsteps fade away. — Five days ago, her back felt like a wall. Now, it feels like a door.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *Yuna approaches in front of the library. Without a word, she hands me a book.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *A bookmark is tucked inside. A single line on the bookmark.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: It was fun. ...See you in the next story.

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *'It was fun.' — That was probably the biggest thing Yuna could say.*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain comes running from in front of the gym.*

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: But hey, it's your choice. Next time you better give me a chance too!

after5_farewell_dain_4_ins.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_ins.text: *She grins and punches my shoulder with her fist. — Same force as the first day.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_ins3.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_ins3.text: *The exclamation marks are alive and well. — Dain is Dain to the very end. That's her strength.*

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *Her retreating figure grows smaller. — But her pace is quick. Just like when we first met.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I left the gym and headed to the back of the school.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *The sun is setting. Five days are coming to an end.*

after5_hidden_route_choice_check.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice_check.text: *My last steps split into two paths. The person I already made a promise to, and the feeling I couldn't keep pretending not to see.*

after5_hidden_route_choice.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice.text: *Where should I go? Today — I have to decide.*
choices: Go to the person I made a promise to
Go to the one still left in my heart

after5_set_harem.name: {name}
after5_set_harem.text: *I walked past the back of the school and headed toward the park. Tonight doesn't feel like it's going to end with just one person.*

after5_harem_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_1.text: *None of us could speak first as we left the back of the school.*

after5_harem_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_2.text: *Carrying the crack we had forced shut, our steps turned toward the park.*

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *My feet stop. The setting sun casts a long shadow behind me.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *At my old school, it was the same. I couldn't say it. And I regretted it. — Am I going to do this again?*

after5_last_chance_2_ins.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins.text: *I almost ran away again. Just like at my old school. Phone in my pocket, unable to say a word — that moment nearly came back. — No. Not this time.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins4.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The sunset at her back.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins6.text: *A moment of silence. The wind blows her hair. She doesn't brush it aside.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins7.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_ins7.text: But — this time, I don't want to just let you go. Because you came back without running away.

after5_last_chance_2_ins8.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins8.text: *She holds out her pinky. The same finger I couldn't take on Day 4.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins10.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins10.text: *Walking side by side — we leave the school behind.*

after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.text: *Seoyeon turns around. Her feet are half-turned away, ready to leave at any moment.* ...What.

after5_last_chance_2_ins14.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins14.text: *Her eyes go wide. One second. Two seconds.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins16.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins16.text: *The exclamation marks disappear. Her voice gets small. — Her eyes are filling up.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins17.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_ins17.text: I — I've been waiting. Since yesterday. No, since the day before yesterday. But just because I waited doesn't mean everything's immediately okay.

after5_last_chance_2_ins18.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins18.text: *She rubs her eyes with her fist. Laughing and crying at the same time.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins19.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_ins19.text: Ugh why are you crying — this is supposed to be happy —

after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.text: *Dain stops, but she can't bring herself to smile.* ...What.

after5_last_chance_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_2.text: *Yuna stops. She hugs the book to her chest. It takes about two seconds for her to turn around.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_4.text: *I don't have anything prepared to say, but strangely, this time I don't want to run. Yuna doesn't rush me.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_5.text: ...This time, I'll listen. Even if I can't say it's okay right away.

after5_last_chance_yuna_6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_6.text: *A short sentence. But those words push me forward. Yuna doesn't look away.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_7.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_7.text: *With her, one line matters more than a long explanation. The problem is — it's my one line.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.text: *Yuna slowly turns around. Her arms tighten around the book she's holding.* ...What.

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *This time, I didn't run. The words came out.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: Hey — I have something to tell you.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *Walking side-by-side.* ...It's late. But at least you didn't run away this time. I won't take those words lightly today.

after5_confess_react_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_low.text: *She stays silent for a long moment.* ...Thanks. But I don't think I can pretend one sentence fixes everything.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *Leaving school.* Hey, really?! ...Really? I mean, I did wait. But if I just smile right away after waiting, that's a bit unfair, isn't it? So this time, say it all the way.

after5_confess_react_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_low.text: *She takes a breath.* ...I heard you. But I can't smile right away yet.

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *We walked side-by-side.* ...I knew it. But today, I'll read it all the way through.

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins.text: *Yuna sets down her book. Her expression doesn't change. — But her hands are trembling.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins3.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins3.text: *She hands me a note. Folded paper. One line when unfolded.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins5.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins5.text: *One line, but the ink is smeared. — She was crying as she wrote it.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins7.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins7.text: *We walked side by side. In silence.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins8.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins8.text: *And so — we walked beyond the school.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_low.text: *She folds the note in her hand.* ...I read it. But I still can't decide on the ending.

after5_confess_fail_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_1.text: *No more words came. As the sun sank lower, we just walked in the same direction for a while.*

after5_confess_fail_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_2.text: *With no answer yet between us, our steps carried us to the park.*

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *My lips won't move. Again. — Again, I couldn't say it.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *The evening breeze blows in. The shadow behind me grows longer. — I'm alone.*

after5_harem_commit.name: {name}
after5_harem_commit.text: *The words I tried to swallow and pretend away finally come out. That I can't choose just one. I know it's cowardly, and even so, tonight I'm going to carry that cost too.*
